text: No, the due-diligence file from June 2025 is no longer valid. As of November 2026, Earth observation data shows that 13.5 hectares (3.91% of the asset) of tree-cover loss occurred in 2025. This loss event is corroborated by two independent datasets (Hansen GFC and JRC GFC2020), which shows that 98% of the lost area was within the 2020 forest cover. The latest update (run-2) includes this new loss, while the June 2025 analysis (run-1) did not yet reflect this event because it only had data up to 2024.
